channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Ottawa girl, 13, seriously injured in Wakefield ski-lift incident
item.description: A 13-year-old girl is in serious condition at CHEO after suffering life-threatening injuries while dismounting a ski chair lift at Vorlage.

item.title: Witnesses sought in west-end Ottawa stabbing
item.description: Ottawa police are looking for possible witnesses to a stabbing Tuesday night in the 1300 block of Woodroffe Avenue.

item.title: Hum: Tomo wants to serve the best sushi in Ottawa. How did it do?
item.description: The ByWard Market restaurant has brought in a Japanese chef to serve exquisite raw fish at its six-seat counter.

item.title: Senators fans fear a repeat of the Dominik Hasek Olympic injury at 2026 Winter Games
item.description: Fans of the Ottawa Senators hope the club's participants return from Italy healthy and ready to help push for a playoff spot

item.title: Is staying small the secret to Ottawa speakeasy success?
item.description: Compact bars have an advantage in the current economic climate, say operators, but there can be a hidden cost.

item.title: Pembroke woman faces Criminal Code charges in dine and dash
item.description: A Pembroke woman was charged under the Criminal Code after allegedly taking off from an establishment without paying her bill.

item.title: Team Canada grades: Binnington brilliant, Wilson a hits machine in win over Czechia
item.description: Jordan Binnington made 26 saves for the shutout, Connor McDavid was the best player on the ice, Sidney Crosby cackled at Father Time, and Cale Makar was dominant on the blue line for Team Canada in a 5-0 win against Czechia.

item.title: Ottawa woman charged in connection with February break-ins
item.description: Woman charged with break-ins following call for public assistance

item.title: O-Train east extension delayed by train availability, axle issues
item.description: OC Transpo is short of the minimum number of train cars it would need during a mandatory 21-day trial running period for the east extension.

item.title: Senators Olympic tracker: Tkachuk, Stutzle each scores beauty goal in respective wins
item.description: Tim Stutzle had two goals for Team Germany, Brady Tkachuk scored and Jake Sanderson was solid for Team USA, and Denmark's Lars Eller played his first ever game at a best-on-best tournament.
